turns.text: My boys, get down on the floor. I can't believe it.
turns.zh: 孩子们，趴到地上去。我真不敢相信。

turns.text: I've got childs! - What are you doing?
turns.zh: 我有孩子！——你们在干什么？

turns.text: - I haven't done anything!
- Don't you come to the wrong house or challenge yet! You're making a big mistake!
turns.zh: ——你们别走错门了，也别来挑战！你们犯了个大错！

turns.text: - For real, Twitter! - What's going on?
- I don't know what's going on! - Oh please, just like phone!
turns.zh: ——我不知道怎么回事！——哦拜托，就跟电话一样！

turns.text: Show me how to get your hands in there! Get your hands in the fucking house!
turns.zh: 把手放到我能看见的地方！把手放到这该死的房子里！

turns.text: I'm gonna get them now!
- Hey, don't look at me! - Hey, don't look at me!
- It's your name, it's the trip! - What's up?
turns.zh: ——是你的名字，是那个行程！——怎么了？

turns.text: It's your name, it's D.I. Bascom.
turns.zh: 是你的名字，是D.I.巴斯康姆。

turns.text: I have a warrant to search your premises, so where's your son?
turns.zh: 我有搜查令搜查你的住所，你儿子在哪？

turns.text: - Where's your son? - He's been through.
- He's been through. - Where is he?
- Mom! - Hey, he's on the edge.
- Ben! - Okay. - Hey! - Jamie Miller.
- What's going on? - The time is 6.15 a.m.
and I'm arresting you on suspicion of murder.
You do not have to say anything but...
turns.zh: 你可以什么都不说，但是……

turns.text: Mr Miller! Mr Miller, I will arrest you for obstruction.
turns.zh: 米勒先生！米勒先生，我会以妨碍公务逮捕你。

turns.text: Please stop. Please.
I'm arresting you on suspicion of murder.
You do not have to say anything but it may harm your defence
turns.zh: 你可以什么都不说，但这可能会损害你的辩护

turns.text: if you do not mention... Dad, I haven't done anything!
turns.zh: 如果你不提及……爸，我什么都没做！

turns.text: Anything you do say may be given an evidence.
turns.zh: 你说的任何话都可能被用作证据。

turns.text: - Dad, I haven't done anything! - Do you understand?
- Do you understand? - Just tell me you understand, Jake!
turns.zh: ——你明白吗？——你就告诉我你明白，杰克！

turns.text: All right, I understand! OK, good.
Get up slowly, please.
You got anything in your pockets that may harm me or you?
turns.zh: 你口袋里有任何可能伤害我或你的东西吗？

turns.text: No. OK.
You want to change your trousers?
But...
Want me to get your dad? Yes, please. Don't move.
turns.zh: 要我叫你爸来吗？是的，请。别动。

turns.text: Stand down, please. Stand down.
Mr Milner, you need to come upstairs. He's had an accident.
turns.zh: 米尔纳先生，你需要上楼来。他出事了。
